Run a query against a given database (default = FISH_MASTER)

db_query.Rd

Executes a SQL query against a given database connection (default = FISH_MASTER) and returns the result as a tibble.

Usage

db_query(query, ...)

Arguments

query

A string containing the SQL query to execute.

...

database and server specific information including the arguments database and server

Value

A tibble::tibble() containing the query result.

Examples

db_query("SELECT TOP 10 * FROM ace.A_ACE")
